title: Build — the code, contained per work item, accounted from base
description: What build made of the binding (SPEC §5 build): one branch, the items in the binding's order, each built by one builder call from a base commit with its change set held to the binding's surface and committed — or blocked, violated or unbuilt, and why. No judge writes any of this: the verdict on it is arithmetic (containment, accounting, the builder's own word), and QA is the judge. Every field is the runner's; the builder's report per item is embedded from build-report. Hashed over the items, so a verdict pinned to it goes stale when an item is rebuilt.

traces.description: What the build was built from, by hash: the pinned handoff, the intake record and the binding.

branch.description: The branch the build's commits are on, in a worktree beside the project's own checkout.

items.description: One entry per binding item, in the binding's order — the build order. An item is `built` (its change set committed), `blocked` (the builder stopped with a reason; nothing kept), `violated` (its change set left the surface or touched the record; nothing kept) or `unbuilt` (the round halted before it).

binding_hash.description: The hash of the binding item this was built from (shared/hash itemHash). Manifest currency: an item whose binding hash and commit both stand is reused for $0; one whose binding moved is rebuilt.

reused.description: True when this round kept a prior round's build of the item without a call — the binding unchanged, the commit on the branch.

base.description: The commit the builder started from; the change set is the diff from here. Null for an item no builder was called on.

commit.description: The commit the item's change set landed as, on the branch. Null unless built.

changed.description: Every path the builder changed from base — modified, added or deleted — whoever committed. Empty unless a builder ran.

violations.description: Paths the change set was not allowed to hold. `record-write`: under the pipeline's own directories. `surface-escape`: outside the binding's surface. A violated item's change set is discarded, not kept.

summary.description: The builder's report on the item, or the runner's word for an item no builder was called on.

reason.description: Blocked: the builder's reason. Violated or unbuilt: the runner's. Built: null.
